blocks.arabic_text: اللهِ وَبِقَوْلِ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ فَإِنَّهَا عِبَادَةُ الْخَلْقِ وَبِهَا تُقْطَعُ أَرْزَاقُهُمْ وَأَنْهَاكَ عَنِ اثْنَتَيْنِ الشِّرْكِ وَالْكِبْرِ فَإِنَّهُمَا يَحْجُبَانِ عَنِ اللهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (الحديث) رواه البزار وفيه محمد بن اسحاق وهو مدلس وهوثقة وبقية رجاله رجال الصحيح، مجمع الزوائد:١٠ /٩٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates: The Prophet ﷺ asked the Sahabah, “Shall I tell you the advice that Hazrat Nuh (AS) gave to his son?” The Sahabah said, “Do tell us, O Messenger!’

blocks.text: “My son! I advise you to do two things, and I forbid you from two things. The first of the things to be done: I command you to say “La ilaha illallah’. For if this Kalimah were placed in one pan of a scale, and the seven heavens and the seven earths were placed in the other pan, the pan of the Kalimah would sink down with its weight. Likewise,” even if the seven heavens and the seven earths were made into an enclosing ring, this Kalimah would break through it and reach Allah. The second of the things to be done: I command you to recite the Tasbih “Subhanallahil Azimi wa bihamdihi’.” For this is the worship of all of creation. It is through its barakah that their needs are fulfilled.

And I keep you away from two things. One is associating partners (with Allah). The other is pride. For these two evil things are what take a servant far away from Allah,” Hazrat Nuh (AS) advised his son.
(Bazzar)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللهِ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: إِنِّي لَاعْلَمُ كَلِمَةً لَايَقُولُهَا رَجُلٌ يَحْضُرُهُ الْمَوْتُ إِلَّا وَجَدَ رُوحُهُ لَهَا رَوْحاً حَتَّي تَخْرُجَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ وَكَانَتْ لَهُ نُورًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَة.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابويعلي ورجاله رجال الصحيح، مجمع الزوائد:٣ /٦٧
